proposition: According to Melvin-Koushki, Henry Corbin presents Ibn Turka as an openly Shiʿi (standard-issue Shiʿi esotericist) thinker, in a study centred on the Risala-yi Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayan-i Saʿat rather than the Tamhid.

mediation.note: The position is this scholar's own; we have it only as summarised by Melvin-Koushki.
MK argues a rival reading (Ibn Turka as occult philosopher) and in places calls this reading an error; his summary may compress or foreshorten it.
